title: Infinitely Many Primes P = M^2 + N^2 with N [larger Than] P^0.1129
summary: We prove that infinitely many primes $p = m^2 + n^2$ have $n < p^{0.1129}$, and that infinitely many primes satisfy ${sqrt{p}} < p^{-0.2742}$. This sharpens the exponents $0.119$ and $-0.262$ of Harman and Lewis (2001). Following their approach, we derive both statements from a lower bound of the correct order of magnitude for the number of Gaussian primes of norm between $X/2$ and $X$ in every sector of angle $X^{-0.3871}$, and we prove this bound with Harman's sieve and their arithmetic information.
